buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE 25% : The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up to 25 percent at the time of issue of the contract. However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 25 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 25 percent with the consent of the service provider 2. Forms of EMD and PBG

Successful Bidder can submit the Performance Security in the form of Fixed Deposit Receipt also (besides PBG which is allowed as per GeM GTC). FDR should be made out or pledged in the name of Principal Financial Advisor/S.E. Railway/Kolkata A/C (Name of the Seller). The bank should certify on it that the deposit can be withdrawn only on the demand or with the sanction of the pledgee. For release of Security Deposit, the FDR will be released in favour of bidder by the Buyer after making endorsement on the back of the FDR duly signed and stamped along with covering letter. Successful Bidder has to upload scanned copy of the FDR document in place of PBG and has to ensure delivery of hard copy of Original FDR to the Buyer within 15 days of award of contract. 3. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. THE VEHICLE MUST BE COMMERCIALLY REGISTERED AS PER THE MOTOR VEHICLES ACT AND S HALL HAVE A VALID INSURANCE CERTIFICATE AND POLLUTION UNDER CONTROL (PUC) CERTIFICATE. THE LIABILITY AND RISK OF COMPREHENSIVE INSURANCE COVERING VEHICLE TH EFT, DAMAGE, INJURY TO PASSENGERS AND THE PUBLIC DUE TO ACCIDENTS, ETC., SHALL BE T HE SOLE RESPONSIBILITY OF THE CONTRACTOR. (PRIVATE REGISTERED VEHICLES SHALL NOT B E PERMITTED).. 2. Vehicle should not be older than 3 calendar years, e.g if bid opening date in years 2026, then vehicle regi stration year allowed should be 2026, 2025, 2024 . At any point of time, vehicles should not be older than 5 years and the vehicle should be BS-VI or latest. 3. A name plate of suitable size is required to be made and fitted on the front of the vehicle The name plate should read "On Duty, Ministry of Railway, Govt. of India". 4. Vehicle colour should be white / white base colours. The vehicle should be mechanically sound and shall b e well maintained with neat and clean Interior/exteriors and hygienic Three pairs of seat-covers and towels to be changed on alternate days. 5. Driver should be provided with white shirt and white pant. The cost of uniforms is to be borne by the cont ractor. 6. The driver must have the valid driving license, must possess good driving skill, obedient and courteous. Dr iver should not be suffering from hyperhidrosis or any other medical conditions resulting in foul body odou r. Medical Certificate to this effect should be provided. The driver must be literate, having good knowledge of roads, navigation skills and familiarities with traffic rules and regulations and should be able to communi cate properly. He should also be able to do the day-to-day maintenance of the vehicle's cleanliness and fun ctionality Driver must have adequate control and patience and remain calm and composed even in stressf ul traffic situations and should never be a part of road rage or reckless driving. 7. All other terms and conditions of the contract for Hiring of Vehicles, which are not specified: Additional Ter ms and Conditions (ATC), will be governed by Service level Agreement (SLA) for monthly basis cab & taxi h iring services of GeM Portal. 8. The vehicle should be available for any outstation duty during the Contract Period. The tallcharges and ot

her taxes for the outstation duty will be borne by the contractor. Vehicle should have valid Fast-tag all the time and duly recharged having sufficient balance and all. 9. In case of any break-down of the vehicle or in any other situation such as the firm fails to provide the allo cated category/model of vehicle, the firm must provide a higher category/model of vehicle as an alternativ e for stop-gap arrangement. 10. The tenderer shall submit their official address, Mobile/phone nos., e-mails (if any) and the driver's mobile number for communication. 11. Driver should have a mobile phone with round the clock availability (24X7) to attend movement/program d etails of the vehicle. Service provider should bear the charges regarding Phone call/SMS communication wi th the user. 12. Driver should not use mobile phone during driving in emergency situation; he should park the vehicle and talk/communicate with the permission of the occupant/passenger. 13. The Railway in no case shall be responsible for any legal matters arising out of any State or Central Govt. l aws/ rules in the matters of employing the driver by vehicle's owner/Contractor. 14. The contractor shall bear the cost of repair or renewal of any kind of Railway properties if damaged by driv er's negligence in rough driving, carelessness. In regard to assessment of such loss on account of damage s, the decision of the Officer for whom vehicle is hired or his representative will be considered as final and binding on the Contractors. 15. Contractor shall be lully responsible for any repair, accident, loss and damages to the vehicle and driver. If any fine or penalty is imposed by various authorities such as Road Transport Officers/Authorities, Traffic po lice etc. for any violation such as speed, traffic rules violation etc., the same will have to borne by the cont ractor only. 16. All hired vehicles should be equipped with prescribed emergency kit and a fire extinguisher as per statutor y provision. 17. No sub-contracting shall be allowed in any case. Vehicles should be in the name of the bidder Vehicle mas t not be and no subletting would be permined by the hired vehicle their 18. The contractor shall submit the bill for the month bill must accompany the certification of officer using the vehicles having day-wise use and kilometer of use and also furnish other documents such as Toll tax, Parki ng fees which need to be countersigned by the officer.

19. However, any penalty or fines etc. imposed by RTA, Police or other law enforcing agencies due to failure/vi olation of traffic rules etc. are not payable to the contractor and such risk and cost will be borne by the con tractor. 20. Other terms and condition will be as per GeM SLA, GEM GCC and other conditions shall be as per GeM upd ated from time to time. .
